persons.name: Kālidāsa
persons.evidence: śrīkālidasana saṃcaya yāṅā || umeśaprītaye pustaṃ, kālidāsena saṃcitaṃ

purpose: śrī3bhavānīśaṃkaraprītina / umeśaprītaye (for the pleasure of Bhavānī-Śaṅkara / Umeśa)
notes: The catalogue lists Kālidāsa as the scribe, but the text states 'kālidasana saṃcaya yāṅā' / 'kālidāsena saṃcitaṃ' (collected/acquired/commissioned the book).
